objective: GHAP周频排班C(每月1/15日12:00CST): 邮箱域从仓内lead样本(tasks/payloads/fob_leads_20260906.json.gz)正则提取(去重≤16域), DNS(MX/A/SPF)+port25 banner 批查, 产出可投递性标记(450灰=对方策略非故障)

shards.expected_output: 域清单JSON(数量+列表, 上限16)

shards.instructions: pip install -q dnspython && python3 -c 'import gzip,re,subprocess;s=gzip.decompress(open("tasks/payloads/fob_leads_20260906.json.gz","rb").read()).decode("utf-8");ds=sorted({m.lower().strip(".") for m in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@([A-Za-z0-9.-]+[.][A-Za-z]{2,})",s)})[:16];print(subprocess.run(["python3","scripts/mail_domain_probe.py"]+ds,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)'
shards.expected_output: 每域 mx/a/spf/port25 banner+verdict 数组JSON
